item.title: Lakeland Community College welcomes trustee to board
item.description: Lake County commissioners have unanimously appointed Kenneth Michael Benz to the Lakeland Community College Board of Trustees. Three of the school’s trustees are appointed by the governor, and six are appointed by the commissioners.
